name: Aleck Connell
bio: Aleck Connell, who had been Ford's freighting partner in 1884, bought teams and outfits in Medora in July 1885, intending to take up a cattle ranch, and by September had bought out Gallup's Cave Hills ranch. In 1886 Lloyd Roberts bought a herd to stock it, to be delivered at Dickinson in late April, and in March the paper reported that Connell had married at Spearfish.

moments.label: Bought Gallup & Walton's Cave Hills ranch

mentions: Aleck Connell, Ford's freighting partner last summer, bought teams and outfit in Medora Tuesday. He intends taking up a ranch in the Bad Lands and stocking it with cattle.
Aleck Connell again descended on Medora last Monday and purchased another outfit, team, wagon, harness &c.

Dr. Jorgens reports that the North Grand stage station is burned. That Aleck Connel has bought out Gallup & Walton's Cave Hills ranch, that the E6 outfit is now in the midst of its beef round-up and that Macy is still playing the role of landlord on the…

…day night. Lloyd will start east soon to buy cattle on contracts he has already secured and may buy for Aleck Connell, who has bought out Gallup's Cave Hills ranch and will stock it this season. Tommy Skinner will again go to "cow-punching" in Aleck's employ.

The report comes from Cave Hills that Aleck Connell, for whom Lloyd Roberts is now buying a herd of cattle, went to Spearfish recently and took unto himself a bride. There is no one who deserves more of this world's joys…

…St. Cloud, states that he has the cattle nearly all bought for his contracts with W. N. Thompson & Co., Aleck Connell and a Montana outfit. Present prices are: yearlings, $15; two's, $21; cows with calves $32. These prices are liable to raise as soon as good grass starts. Lloyd expects…
Lloyd Roberts will arrive in Medora about the 25th., delivering at Dickinson Aleck Counell's herd for his Cave Hills ranch.
